title: Unterstützung unter dem Puck
observableEvidence: who supports whom under the puck
pass lane / distance / body orientation / timing cues
evaluationFocus: functional support relationship, not player list
visible playability cues (lane, distance, orientation, timing)
requiredForStrong: identifies support relationship with observable anchors
does not judge 'good/bad support' as the evidence itself
commonFailureModes: outcome-only praise from the next pass/goal
fairnessNote: One well-anchored support relation can score excellent. Pattern synthesis across many samples is out of scope for quality.
minimalInputChange: Required sample note ≥150 chars (max 250) on logged moments; states/factors remain structured.
